### Interactive Plot

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
source("code.R")

df_sf$longitude <- sf::st_coordinates(df_sf)[, 1]
df_sf$latitude <- sf::st_coordinates(df_sf)[, 2]

df_sf <- df_sf |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml:Ammonia_ppm,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "values"
    )  
```


```{r}
layout_sidebar(
  height = 600,
  sidebar = sidebar(
    shiny::selectizeInput(
      'select_area',
      'Visible Areas',
      choices = unique(df_sf$Area_name),
      selected = c(
        "River Fynn and River Lark",
        "Tidal River Deben",
        "Non-Tidal River Deben"
      ),
      multiple = TRUE
    )
  ),
  shiny::plotOutput('output_plot')
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$output_plot <- shiny::renderPlot({
  df_sf |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Area_name %in% input$select_area,
      variable == "E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml"
    ) |>
    ggplot(
      aes(x = date_actual, y = values)
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(color = Area_name),
      se = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 2
    ) +
    labs(y = "E.coli Colonies per 1ml", x = "Date") +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey98"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      # aes(color = E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml),
      aes(color = Area_name),
      size = 4,
      width = 10
    ) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scico::scale_color_scico_d()
})
```

### Interactive Map

```{r}

library(leaflet)

max_month = max(lubridate::month(df_sf$date_actual), na.rm = TRUE)
min_month = min(lubridate::month(df_sf$date_actual), na.rm = TRUE)
layout_sidebar(
  height = 600,
  sidebar = sidebar(
    shiny::sliderInput(
      'month_range_map',
      'Month Range',
      min = min_month,
      max = max_month,
      value = c(max_month, max_month),
      step = 1,
      dragRange = TRUE
    ),
    shiny::selectizeInput(
      'select_variable',
      'Water quality variables',
      choices = c(
        "E. coli" = "E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml",
        "Phosphate PO4" = "Phosphate_PO4_mgpL",            
        "Phosphate P" = "Phosphate_P_mgpL",
        "Nitrate" = "Nitrate_ppm",               
        "Ammonia" = "Ammonia_ppm"
      ),
      selected = c("E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml"),
      multiple = FALSE
    )
  ),
  leafletOutput("map", width = "100%", height = "100%")
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server
# Create the map
library(leaflet)

# Load river data
rivers_sf <- sf::st_read("data/four_rivers.gpkg") |> sf::st_transform(4326)

# Filter data based on month range
observe({
  title_str <- dplyr::case_match(
    input$select_variable,
    "E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml" ~ "E. coli<br/>(Colonies/ml)",
    "Phosphate_PO4_mgpL" ~ "Phosphate PO<sub>4</sub><br/>(mg/L)",            
    "Phosphate_P_mgpL" ~ "Phosphate P <br/>(mg/L)",
    "Nitrate_ppm" ~ "Nitrate (ppm)",               
    "Ammonia_ppm" ~ "Ammonia (ppm)"
  )

  filtered_data <- df_sf |>
    tidyr::drop_na(values) |> 
    dplyr::filter(
      variable == input$select_variable,
      lubridate::month(date_actual) >= input$month_range_map[1],
      lubridate::month(date_actual) <= input$month_range_map[2]
    ) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(values_scaled = scales::rescale(values, to = c(200, 800)))

  # Create color palette for E. coli values
  pal <- colorNumeric(
    palette = "viridis",
    domain = filtered_data$values
  )

  leafletProxy("map", data = filtered_data) |>
    clearShapes() |>
    clearControls() |> # Clear existing legends
    # Add rivers first (below points)
    addPolylines(
      data = rivers_sf,
      color = "#0066CC",
      weight = 3,
      opacity = 0.8
    ) |>
    # Add circles on top
    addCircles(
      ~longitude,
      ~latitude,
      radius = ~values_scaled, # Scaled radius
      stroke = FALSE,
      fillOpacity = 0.7,
      fillColor = ~ pal(values)
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      pal = pal,
      values = ~values,
      title = title_str,
      position = "bottomright",
      opacity = 0.7
    )
})

output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  leaflet() %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    setView(lng = 1.337325608, lat = 52.08806268, zoom = 11)
})
```
